notes.title: Steam Game Festival 2021: Linked Mask hands-on preview
notes.content:
Take the addictive nature of Celeste, add a Mega Man inspired stage select, spice things up with some basic combat, and present it with a purposefully limited palette that smacks of the most recognizable gaming handheld. Linked Mask takes this formula and mixes up a batch of six grueling towers that will test the limits of your platforming prowess. Set on conquering a deity atop each stage, doing so will grant the player with a different mask and accompanying power. With tight controls, multiple abilities and weapons, clever stage design, and top-notch beats, Linked Mask is the game for any platforming perfectionist.

The game looks very close to what we remember a GameBoy game looking like, but with several enhancements to bring it into 2021. Impressive parallax scrolling improves every scene with some truly awe-inspiring elements that foreshadow incredible set pieces. The pixel art is tastefully constrained while densely detailed, conveying your progression with bold shifts in background art. The graphic style and the forced limitations placed upon it hearken back to a simpler time and it's a fairly successful nostalgia trip. Overall the demo for Linked Mask shows off a considerable number of backgrounds as you try your ascent repeatedly. And you will try repeatedly.

Precise controls are a necessity for any game that demands such rinse and repeat gameplay, and Linked Mask provides meticulous platforming for a challenging summit. Slopes will send you careening with physical abandon into traps, tumbling through the blue and green backdrops. Hazards come in all forms as you gain altitude through the tower. From requisite spikes and lasers, to moving platforms and Thwompian blocks, there's always an obstacle that will need fast thinking and faster fingers to overcome. With some focus and determination, you can turn this monolith mounting simulator into a truly sublime steeple scaler.

A soundtrack that rivals any indie game I have played motivates repeated attempts at climbing the spire of The Non Mole. Sega inspired tunes accompany the opening area, complete with smooth synths, wailing electric guitar, and perfect bass lines that fade into strings. The next track is much jazzier and bouncier, matching the change in platforming mechanics on offer for the second segment of the tower exactly. The next area of the tower ramps up the precision to an extreme and the music here is so good, I want to listen to it outside of the game. A four-on-the-floor house song drives the player forward in this section. The incessant deaths that you will rack up here will be a mere setback while the groove pushes on, dropping the bass exactly as you get into the zone.

Anyone that enjoyed Celeste should easily give Linked Mask a try. The gameplay and control will feel instantly familiar but the game is different enough that it feels fresh while trying to look dated. Any fan of platformers in general would be remiss to let this demo pass by unplayed. Spoonman Games have crafted an experience that feels inspired by opposite eras in game design and come up with a fun yet painfully precise action adventure. If that isn't enough to get you interested, try it for the music then, you'll be nodding your head and stuck on "one more try" until you find yourself at the top of the tower. The wait for the rest of Linked Mask might be a while longer, with no set release date currently. Make sure you attempt to scale this software while the demo is available during the Steam Game Festival.

This preview is based on a public Steam demo. The Linked Mask demo is available now as part of the Steam Game Festival 2021 and is set to release TBA.

notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.4
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback so far! We will keep pushing updates during the event so please share all your thoughts about the game, we really appreciated it :)

[h3]v0.3.4[/h3]

[list]
[*] We have checked and removed a lot of instances where some grass and spikes were in the same tile making the spikes very hard to see.
[*] We have fixed the placement of some foreground elements in the Learn section so these don't obstruct the view when jumping is required.
[*] Colliders of the world were reviewed and fine-tuned, there were some weird slope and walls that now have correct collision shapes.
[*] Fixed a soft-lock bug in the Kaizo zone where if you got to the second checkpoint and the Crusher killed you just there it's position didn't reset, making you respawn inside the Crusher killing you over and over again.
[/list]

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.3
notes.content:
Some changes have been done to help you better go through the Kaizo zone :)

[h3]v0.3.3[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Electrical Lines sprites so their On and Off states are way easier to differentiate.
[*] Updated a part on the Kaizo Zone where a small jump needed to be performed, the jump is still required but the gap to go through is a little bigger to make it easier to go by.
[*] FIxed a bug in the Start zone where some rocks didn't reset properly upon dying, You could collide with those rocks, even break them but not seem them. This is now fixed.
[/list]

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: Play New Demos by HypeTrain Digital – Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hi!

We’re delighted to take part in the Steam Game Festival (June 16 - June 22), which is already live now! Throughout the event we've brought demos for each of the 8 games we are currently working on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/7abeae814099c7e99930eac874f252bae2418cb1.jpg[/img]

All of them are in different genres, settings and styles. You will surely find something that piques your interest! All the content available for Steam Summer Festival is free, some demos are long, some allow infinite play. Here is a little sneak peek of every title available.

[h1]Voidtrain[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/24e19a0b140c0b6ba83248df68f6e3487ea01ea7.jpg[/img]

Voidtrain is a first-person action/survival game where you become a crew member of an interdimensional express. Build your own train, upgrade it, craft weapons and travel across different mysterious worlds full of outlandish creatures, Nazis and other dangers. 

https://youtu.be/o0bIODWSX5Y

Voidtrain’s demo features a base loop of the game, where you’ll be able to travel between biomes on your train, gather resources to upgrade it and stop by interdimensional train depots filled with Nazis ought to be defeated.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159690/Voidtrain/

[h1]Tunche[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/808ffccf6882a1b363b56fb5974520d31e81bbbe.jpg[/img]

Tunche is a charming, hand-drawn beat'em up hack and slash game with roguelike elements, co-op and a pinch of shaman witchcraft. Visit the amazonian jungle alone or together with your friends, choose one of the 5 unique characters and hack through hordes of enemies!

And if you like A Hat in Time, we got a big surprise for you — Hat Kid will be the 5th Playable Character in the game. Moreover, you’ll be able to test her in the demo! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/887450/Tunche/

[h1]Linked Mask[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/836f39a47efe14ee46476b2b34cd0b1589117e91.jpg[/img]

Do you miss the golden era of Game Boy? Linked Mask is a 2D platformer that will make you reminiscent of the good old days, where a player has to overcome six towers, collect six masks containing elemental powers and ultimately conquer the Castle of the Primals. And there’s a chillingly cool soundtrack that will make your head bop as you traverse the deadly Towers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111590/Linked_Mask/

[h1]Jack Move[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/f8610a50c9a9492fa4b446b492de33263cedb4ad.gif[/img]

Plunge into a VHS-era cyberpunk world of Jack Move, an RPG featuring japanese style turn based battles and gorgeous Hi-Bit pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0yOLVvhsJFw

There’s a brand new demo of Jack Move available that features a new slums area, a new dungeon and a whole bunch of new enemies for you to tangle with. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099640/Jack_Move/

[h1]Black Book[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/acc2d0ccff5b5a3512dca0a38d0825549dedb276.gif[/img]

Black Book is a dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic mythology and featuring card-based combat. You will take on the role of Vasilisa, a young sorceress on a quest to revive her beloved one. In order to do so, she has to uncover all the 7 seals of Black Book — a demonic artefact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish. 

The demo features an essential part of the story — the First Day of Vasilisa becoming a witch. You’ll be able to test test the core game mechanics, battle regular demons and even test your strength in a fight against a boss.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

[h1]There Is No Light[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/9543af773b7ab1760c993449121e62b139a6e6c0.jpg[/img]

There Is No Light is a pixel-art action adventure in a dark post-apocalyptic setting, which tells a story of a protagonist fighting against a fallen underground civilization and its appalling religious rituals. 

In this demo you’ll be able to explore a small part of the game world. Visit a village, the existence of which remained unknown for a long time. Find out how people live in the underground world ruled by the Church of the Great Hand. Find your own playstyle by combining 3 available weapon types, so that eventually you can fight a giant boss Behemoth that gets in your way to freedom.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h1]Tower Princess[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/403d20cb011202cd3f6da5a5f5c44bfa5e63aca8.jpg[/img]

Tower Princess is a 3D roguelike action platformer where you'll have to beat a dungeon, defeat a dragon, rescue a princess/prince and manage a perfect date with them! There’s a wide variety of royalty members you can hit on — you’ll be able to find someone you like even if you’re not into humans. 

The demo is a linear and brief sample of a run in one of the Castle's areas. It shows the visuals and the core gameplay of Tower Princess, but it's focused on the princess aid in combat, as without her help, you wouldn't stand a chance against the Evil Dragon. Are you ready to test yourself as a knight in shining armour?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138650/Tower_Princess/

[h1]SuchArt![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/58eec9f3b1771872af7c94beb1b8d603f48ce8ec.gif[/img]

SuchArt is a painting sim game featuring you being such an amazing artist. Really you rock, your latest DNA test is very positive about it. Now please paint, sell and expose your art from your new studio aboard the Space City. And don’t forget — the only limit is the size of your brush (or a flamethrower).

SuchArt demo features a separate room (a virtual studio instead of a real one you’ll get in the full game) with a limited amount of tools and an introductory part of the story. However, you’ll be able to test the core game mechanics and take a couple of commissions from virtual clients, which is already fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt/

notes.title: Patchnotes update v0.3.2
notes.content:
We have made a quick update to address some small issues with the Linked Mask Demo.

[*]The game now starts by default in full-screen and with vSync on. If you already opened the game before this fix you will have to start a Stage, open the pause menu, go to options and there change the resolution manually. These options are saved for when you reopen the game.

[*]Additional gameplay elements have been added to the Kaizo zone.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is out and Non Mole Boss Fight Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Today is the Day! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival]Steam Game Festival, Summer Editon[/url] has begun! During this time you'll be able to play the Demo of Linked Mask, we are eager to hear all your feedback :)

[previewyoutube=hEIwkGDw-d0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The moment of judgment has arrived and the Demo of Linked Mask is now available, Non Mole will judge Viewer in his devil Dance, putting you between the sword and the thunder, literally. Without no more words to say.

If you believe that it would be an easy final step, don't expect this Deity to bow easily.

Have at you, joyful Viewer.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326328/7eae1fdd55c8644609d054cfa471c31424a077f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Kaizo Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Tomorrow the Demo will go live as soon as the Steam Summer Event begins! We will be very active here in Steam during that time, looking at your feedback, hot-fixing any weird bugs and making a few live streams :) 

And now for a new video on this adventure to the demo release:

[previewyoutube=HTtJ-B-UgL0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The Kaizo zone is full of traps that will fully test the capacity of Viewer and with a big tribute to his ancestors he will be able to acquire an upgrade given by the Primal Gods.

The objective of this game is to play in a fast and precise way, speed will usually be steady, let yourself carry on to the beats of the game and dance to the Deities' songs.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326328/1eb3c3317843adb1f1e23393da702e5e2ef43a55.png[/img]

I hope you are looking forward to playing the game!

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: Learn Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

Next week the Demo will go live! We have made quite some updates to the demo that we hope you highly enjoy, there is still a lot of work to be done in this last stretch of development, but we are very excited to show to the public what we have.

[previewyoutube=N4En-R2HjSU;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The truth in Linked Mask will be known trough the Masks that Viewer will collect in his adventure, but you also need to learn how to use them, each Tower will feature a Learn zone filled with the frozen souls that keep these places alive. Master Thunder and earn your right to keep the Mask.

The hands shaped a path so you could know why Linked Mask is so eccentric in its way to show its detailed pixel art, regardless of all the technical limitations, the game feels like one.

Our hands are willing to change.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326328/c921981f9a53729ad5ca6e0b2824e20ab9e5626f.png[/img]

I hope you are looking forward to playing the game!

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: New Demo release Date!
notes.content:
Hello!

Just recently we have noticed that Steam has delayed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival]The Steam Game Festival Summer Edition[/url] to June 16th, 10 AM PDT. We are part of this event so the demo itself won't be available until the Festival starts.

I hope you can keep up with us for another week while we wait for the event to begin! In the meantime, we have worked some updates for the demo so at least you will have more content to enjoy :)

The Spoonman Games Team.

notes.title: The Non Mole Electric Tower
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

We re preparing for the upcoming Steam Summer Event, making sure the demo is in good shape, in the meantime here are some words from our Game Director and a new [b]video[/b] about the level you will be playing this June 9th!

[previewyoutube=Xvb48BafNu4;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]In Linked Mask you will find the Non Mole Electric Tower, there you will go through different rails that will transform you into electricity itself! There will be guards stopping you in every step, but be careful and climb your way up the tower.

This tower holds big generators inside, back in his day it served the civilization responsible for creating the towers, but now the tower it's on its own and its power is still real, electricity will go against you, testing your skill to the max.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326328/91b8fa9995267beba86f58c26bb2b2cfaf99b37b.png[/img]

I hope you are looking forward to playing the game!

The Spoonman Games team.

notes.title: The road to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326328/3bd5f7efde7b91e97bee238fde1d85936dbbd91a.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We've been working [i]really[/i] hard amid these difficult times, getting closer to the final game each day and we are feeling confident in starting to share what we've done and what's to come, there is a lot to talk and a lot we want you to see ～

Starting today we will be using this platform to share all the important news and announcements of the game and also some cool Artwork!

Our first important announcement will go live [b]tomorrow[/b], and later we will be doing at least one post each week to keep you all up to date. We are very excited about what's ahead and I hope you all can join us in this adventure <3

In the meantime you can see some cool gifs and images of the game in any of our leads Twitter:
